Thanks for the context. Quick notes after an initial pass:

- 45-day dispute window: we can accept 45 days for invoice disputes, but propose an express clause that disputes must be logged via the billing portal with description and supporting docs; otherwise invoices age into payable status.
- Indemnity: we cannot broadly accept a carveout for third-party model IP without narrowing (propose: carveout limited to claims that arise solely from customer modifications to models or from Customer-provided integrations).
- Termination notice: switching to 12-months (from 30 days) materially changes our ability to reallocate capacity; propose compromise 90 days for term changes tied to capacity uplifts greater than 50%.

Procurement / PO flow: PO-first is OK; clarify in the cover letter that the PO authorizes purchase order processing only and signature of the MSA remains a separate legal acceptance. We will also add a short note about revenue ops handling: finance will set a provisioning flag on forecast but will not recognize revenue until MSA countersigned.

I will prepare redline language and upload a tracked-changes Word file before our 10:00 PT walkthrough. Can you confirm the meeting invite?
